description: Sonic 3 & Knuckles website hero loop: AIZ loop opening, zones in game order with bonus and special stages, rewind and Data Select mid-reel, donation shots last; hard cuts, fade at the loop ends.

shots.label: Angel Island Act 1: through the loop
Angel Island Act 1: flame craft
Blue Spheres special stage from the Angel Island giant ring
shots.note: Declared position beside the AIZ2 giant ring the complete-run movie enters; authored entry and stage turns (inputs/s3k-aiz2-special-ring.script). Following the complete-run movie from the AIZ1 level start drifts: the direct boot's spindash release differs from the post-intro recording, and a teleport into the AIZ1 lower cave dies below the event-owned camera bound.

shots.label: Hydrocity Act 1: a chain of Sonic sidekicks
Hydrocity Act 1: whirlpool miniboss
Marble Garden Act 1: drill miniboss
Carnival Night Act 1: bumpers and slopes
Gumball Machine bonus stage
IceCap Act 1: snowboard
Angel Island Act 2: a bomb hits, live rewind undoes it
shots.note: Declared position before the bombing run with the 72 rings the complete-run movie carries there. A bomb hits at frame 576; the held rewind key (630:90) restores the pre-hit state; authored jumps then clear the bombs.

shots.label: Launch Base Act 1: results
Data Select: saves with custom teams
shots.note: Declared Data Select setup: six generated save slots with custom teams, zones and emeralds (inputs/s3k-data-select-saves.json) and three extra team combos; the cursor walks the saves and cycles the NEW slot's team (inputs/s3k-data-select-teams.script).

shots.label: Mushroom Hill Act 1: pulleys and forest
Flying Battery Act 2: lightning shield
Glowing Spheres bonus stage
Sandopolis Act 1: desert loop
Lava Reef: boss over the lava
shots.note: hpz22_completerun is zone $16: the Lava Reef boss act, then Hidden Palace. The lrz_completerun replay loses Sonic before its fast sections.

shots.label: Hidden Palace: crystal halls
shots.note: Direct Hidden Palace boot following the complete-run movie from the act's start (movie frame 380459 + trace row 9462); the trace replay diverges before this act.

shots.label: Sky Sanctuary Act 1
Death Egg Act 1
shots.note: Committed cold DEZ1 route; the ssz_completerun (zone $0B) replay times out before its fast sections.

shots.label: Death Egg: a chain of Sonics at the Death Egg Robot
shots.note: Zone $17 with a Sonic sidekick chain following the complete-run movie. The ROM parks the sidekicks once the robot fight begins (about frame 560), so the chain is filmed on the run-up.

shots.label: Doomsday: Super Sonic chases the Eggman ship
shots.note: Committed DDZ route with the seven Chaos Emeralds it declares. Doomsday spawns no sidekicks, so a Sonic chain is not available here.

shots.label: Sonic 2 donating: Super Sonic in Mushroom Hill
shots.note: Declared seven emeralds and 60 rings; with Sonic 2 donating, the movie's next jump transforms him through Sonic 2's Super rules. The donated team leaves the recorded line after about 3.5 s.

shots.label: Sonic 1 donating: Sonic spirals through the Flying Battery wire cages
shots.note: Declared position east of the three wire cages the complete-run movie spirals through; authored run left (inputs/s3k-fbz1-s1-wire-cage.script).
